objectives: List the notarial proceedings in Art. 569 of the Civil Procedure Code.
Decide which notary may perform a given act, depending on the location of the property.
Recognise the relations that oblige a notary to step aside.
List the breaches that make a notarial act null.
Explain what a refusal is, how it is appealed and within what time.

cards.front: Which notary issues a deed of sale of real estate?
cards.back: The notary in whose **district the property is** (Art. 570(1) ГПК).

cards.front: Which notary may make a will or certify a power of attorney?
When is a written request needed?
cards.back: For deeds transferring or creating real rights in real estate, certification of ownership, and entries, notes and deletions (Art. 571 ГПК).
**Parties**: in whose name the act is requested. **Participants**: whose personal statements the notary certifies (Art. 572 ГПК).

cards.front: Where and when may deeds for entry be issued?
cards.back: Only **in the office** and only **in working hours** (Art. 573(2) ГПК).
Spouse/cohabitant; ascendants and descendants; collaterals to the **4th degree**; in-laws to the **1st degree**; guardianship, adoption, foster relations (Art. 575(1) ГПК).

cards.front: Does recusal apply if the document only benefits the notary's relative?
cards.back: **Yes**, if it contains a disposition in their favour (Art. 575(2) ГПК).

cards.front: Name four breaches that make a notarial act null.
cards.back: No competence or wrong district; outside the district; illegal deal; recusal; no personal appearance; no reading/signing; missing essential content; no interpreter (Art. 576 ГПК).

cards.front: Where is a notary's refusal appealed?
cards.back: With a **private appeal** before the **regional court** (Art. 577(1) ГПК).

cards.front: Time limit for a private appeal?
What can a creditor do with a notarial deed for a loan?
cards.back: Ask the court for an **order for immediate enforcement** (Art. 417(1), item 3 and Art. 418 ГПК).
When the act is **performed**; for a circumstantial verification, when the request is **made** (Art. 88 ЗННД).

quiz.question: A client from Sofia owns a flat in Plovdiv and wants to sell it while staying in Sofia. Which notary issues the deed?
options: A notary from the Plovdiv district
Any notary in Sofia
Any notary in Bulgaria
The notary of the buyer's choice anywhere
quiz.explanation: Deeds for real estate are issued by the notary in whose district the property is. The seller may sign a power of attorney in Sofia.

quiz.question: Which act may a notary in Sofia perform for a property in Varna?
options: Certify the signature and content of a power of attorney to sell it
Issue the sale deed
Issue a declaratory deed of ownership
Issue a mortgage deed
quiz.explanation: Only acts other than deeds for real rights and certifications of ownership are free of the property rule.

quiz.question: For which act is a written request required?
options: A deed for a gift of a house
A certification of a signature on a declaration
A certification of a copy
A notarial invitation
quiz.explanation: A written request is required for deeds about real rights in real estate, certifications of ownership and entries.

quiz.question: The buyer is the notary's first cousin. May the notary issue the deed?
options: No, first cousins are collaterals of the fourth degree
Yes, cousins are not covered
Yes, with the consent of the seller
Yes, if the assistant notary signs
quiz.explanation: Collaterals up to the fourth degree are covered; first cousins are fourth-degree relatives.

quiz.question: The notary's sister-in-law (the brother's wife) is a party. Is the notary recused?
options: No, in-laws are covered only to the first degree, and a brother's wife is a second-degree in-law
Yes, all in-laws are covered
Yes, always
Only if she lives with the notary
quiz.explanation: Art. 575(1) covers in-laws up to the first degree only (parents-in-law, children-in-law). The notary may still decline under Art. 23 ЗННД if impartiality is in doubt.

quiz.question: A notary issued a sale deed for a flat in another district. What is the status of the deed?
options: Null
Valid but voidable
Valid if entered
Valid if the parties agree
quiz.explanation: Breach of Art. 570(1) makes the act null.

quiz.question: The seller did not come; his brother signed "for him" without a power of attorney. What is the status?
options: Null for lack of personal appearance of the participant
Valid if the seller later agrees
Voidable within three years
Valid because the brother is family
quiz.explanation: Breach of Art. 578(4) about personal appearance makes the act null.

quiz.question: Within what time can a client appeal the notary's refusal?
options: One week from notification
One month
Two weeks
Three days
quiz.explanation: Private appeals are filed within one week.

quiz.question: The regional court sets aside a refusal of an entry. When is the entry deemed made?
options: From the moment of the request for entry
From the date of the court decision
From the date of the new request
From the next working day

quiz.question: A patient in hospital needs a power of attorney certified today. Is it possible?
options: Yes, outside the office for good reasons, with an additional fee
No, all acts are only in the office
Only on weekends
Only if the patient sends a relative
quiz.explanation: Acts other than deeds for entry may be done outside the office when good reasons require it.

quiz.question: Why do lenders prefer a loan contract with notarially certified signatures?
options: It allows an order for immediate enforcement
It reduces the interest rate
It makes the loan tax-free
It is required for all loans
quiz.explanation: Art. 417(1), item 3 ГПК covers notarial deeds and contracts with certified signatures for money obligations.

quiz.question: When does the client pay the fee for a circumstantial verification?
options: When the request is made, and it is not returned if ownership is not recognised
After the deed is issued
Only if the ownership is recognised
At the end of the year
quiz.explanation: Art. 88(1) ЗННД and the note to item 11 of the tariff.
